name: Tahonda Ruins
summary: Salt and sand cover Tahonda Ruins, where Saltstone basilisks stalk the remains of an ancient tauren settlement in the Shimmering Flats.

sections.title: Sunken beneath the Salt
sections.body:
Tahonda Ruins lie in the southern Shimmering Flats, near the pass into Tanaris. Salt crusts cover the weathered remains of this abandoned tauren village, and strange marks scar the surviving structures.

Two sets of three parallel tears cut through the leather of a ruined lodge. No one knows whether Saltstone basilisks drove the villagers away. The marks point to a violent end at the claws of powerful predators or hostile invaders, before the desert claimed what remained.

faq.q: What were the Tahonda Ruins originally?
faq.answer: Tahonda was once a tauren village on the dry Shimmering Flats. Shifting sands and salt crusts gradually swallowed it into ruin.

No written history records why the village was abandoned. Saltstone basilisks overrun the ruins now and may have driven the settlers away. Deep, three-clawed tears in the surviving leather lodges also suggest a sudden, violent attack.

faq.q: What creatures live in the ruins now?
faq.answer: Hostile Saltstone basilisks infest the village remains now. They sun themselves among rotting wooden poles and tattered hide shelters.

angles.text: Among the salt of Thousand Needles, a forgotten tauren settlement recalls the dangers your nomadic ancestors faced while wandering Kalimdor.
